DILG Republic of the Philippines I IME. DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Tria I http://vwm.dilg.com.ph OILG OPINION NO. L__ MAYOR JOSE B. ENSAGNA Municipality of Santa Fe Province of Cebu Dear Mayor Ensagna: s. 204 This has reference to your letter dated 13 February 2019, requesting for this Department's intervention on the following: i. ii. iii. Inactions or halting the required resolutions authorizing the Local Chief Executive to sign MOA or Contract (without valid reasons or justifications) for some funded programs and projects of National Government Agencies and/or LGUs/NGOs intended for the LGU-Municipality of Santa Fe; Per Resolution 83-2016 adopting "internal rules of procedure of SB of Santa Fe", Rule III, Section 6, states that regular sessions be done every Monday of the month, but for various times, the SB council of Santa Fe conducted their SB regular sessions on other days of the month without adopting prior notice (if allowed to change outright) and without adopting prior resolution so the public with concern can be guided accordingly; The Local Water Utilities Administration (LWUA) through the LWUA Acting Administrator, Mr. Jeci A. Lapus, has sent a letter (as per attached) to DILG Secretary, Gen. Eduardo M. Aio asking for an assistance to enlighten the SB ofSanta Fe to finally turn-over the existing water supply system to Santa Fe Water District. With respect to your first concern, please be informed that prior authorization from the sanggunian is not always necessary. Attention is invited to Section 22 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code" (LGC), viz: "SEC.22(c) Unless otherwise provided in this Code, no contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit without prior authorization by the sanggunian concerned. A legible copy of such contract shall be posted at a conspicuous place in the provincial capitol or the city, municipality or barangay hall. "

Based on the afore-quoted provision of the LGC, the Municipal Mayor may enter into contracts, for and in behalf of the municipality (l) if made upon authority of the sanggunian, or (2) pursuant to law or ordinance2. This has been the view settled by this Department in its legal opinions, such as, DILG Legal Opinion No. 22, S.2015, dated 7 July 2015, Legal Opinion No. 34, S.2015, dated 25 August 2015 and the like. In the latter case, if a law or ordinance already authorizes the Municipal Mayor to enter into a contract, prior authorization from the Sanggunian concerned is not anymore required. Such law or ordinance serves as an authority for the Mayor to enter such contract. This is precisely the exception being referred by the phrase "Unless otherwise provided in this Code "in the opening statement of Section 22(c) of the LGC. Thus, the Mayor may represent the municipality in all its contracts even without a prior authorization from the Sangguniang Bayan, for as long as there is either a law or ordinance that authorizes him/her to do so. If there is no law or ordinance authorizing the Mayor to enter such contract, the same falls within the first case and therefore requires prior authorization from the Sangguniang Bayan. However, if it is your belief that the delay in executing an authorization is without valid reason and/or justification to the detriment of public service, may we advise you that Section 61 (b)3 of the LGC allows you to file an administrative complaint against elective local officials on the ground of dereliction of duty pursuant to Section 60(c) of the LGC. On your second query, we believe that the matter proffered therein is governed by the internal rules of procedure (IRP) of the sanggunian pursuant to Section 50 of the Local Government Code, viz: "SECTION 50. Internal Rules of Procedure. - (a) On the first regular session following the election of its members and within ninety (90) days thereafier, the Sanggunian concerned shall adopt or update its existing rules of procedure. (b) The rules ofprocedure shall provide for the following: (I) The organization of the Sanggunian and the election of its officers as well as the creation of standing committees which shall include, but shall not be limited to, the committees on appropriations, women and family, human rights, youth and sports development, DILG Legal Opinion No. 22, S2015, dated 7 July 2015 3 SECTION 61. Form and Filing ofAdministrative Complaints. - A verified complaint against any erring local elective official shall be prepared as follo ws: AXA- (b) A complaint against any elective official ofa municipality shall be filed before the Sangguniang Panlalawigan whose decision may be appealed to the Office of the President.

environmental protection, and cooperatives; the general jurisdiction of each committee; and the election of the chairman and members of each committee; (2) The order and calendar of business for each session; (3) The legislative process; (4) The parliamentary procedures which include the conduct of members during sessions; (5) The discipline of members for disorderly behavior and absences without justifiable cause for four (4) consecutive sessions, for which they may be censured, reprimanded, or excluded from the session, suspended for not more than sixty (60) days, or expelled: Provided, That the penalty of suspension or expulsion shall require the concurrence ofat least two-thirds (2/3) vote of all the Sanggunian members: Provided, further, That a member convicted by final judgment to imprisonment of at least one (1) year for any crime involving moral turpitude shall be automatically expelled from the Sanggunian; and (6) Such other rules as the Sanggunian may adopt. ' Hence, this Department is constrained from answering the said issue as the same is governed by your IRP. Relative to your last concern, may we inform you that there is no attached letter herein addressed to Secretary Allo, asking for an assistance to enlighten the SB of Santa Fe to finally turn-over the existing water supply system to Santa Fe Water District. Thus, we cannot evaluate the same. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secret MARIVEL C. S N O, CESO 111 CC: U de ecretary Dir. Leocadio T. Trovela Regional Director DILG-Region VII (Central Visayas) Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City
